InputBoundary: Read-only access to the exact governed versioned object under inspection, its contemporaneously declared identity/version metadata, and any bounded comparison identities supplied for distinguishability inspection.
HarnessBehaviour: Locate and record the object's explicit version identifier; verify that the identifier is present, non-empty, unambiguous and attributable to the governed object; preserve the identifier location and observed value; compare against any supplied relevant version identities where distinguishability must be demonstrated; fail closed where the version is missing, empty, ambiguous, unattributable, indistinguishable, or can be established only through retrospective reconstruction.
DecisionAuthority: Harness may mechanically determine presence, non-emptiness, exact observed version value, explicit attribution to the inspected object, and distinguishability from supplied comparison identities only.
HumanAuthorityBoundary: No semantic or governance judgment is delegated to the harness. The harness SHALL NOT infer an intended version, repair or synthesize missing metadata, select among ambiguous candidate versions, substitute external chronology for explicit object identity, or retrospectively construct version continuity.
EvidenceBoundary: Governed object identity; inspected object provenance; version-identifier field or location; observed version value; presence/non-empty determination; ambiguity determination; attribution evidence; supplied comparison identities where applicable; distinguishability determination; failure reason where applicable; contemporaneous inspection record.
